findings.claim: Original preview.log (8 lines, full file) contains no successful generator summary line and no echoed diff command; it shows only two 'Files ... differ' fragments and check_exit=1 (stale), so the '1 page written, 0 pruned; no unexpected path' assertion is not demonstrated by that artifact.

gen-wiki.mjs hardcodes the literal string 'wiki/' in its written/pruned and up-to-date log lines instead of the resolved WIKI_DIR, so when invoked with --wiki-dir pointing at a temp probe dir the printed summary reads as if the real wiki/ was written/current when only the temp copy was touched.
